title: He Still Has the Floor. Playtest and feedback requested.
author: Interesting-Act-1958
selftext:
A physics toy about a man who will not stop talking.

There is a walrus in this office. He has the floor, and he will not give it up. Not for questions. Not for lunch. Not even for the fire alarm.

You have one job: make it quiet.

The win is silence. Not damage.

He's an indestructible cartoon ragdoll. Smack him with a chair, throw the stapler, drag him across the room — pain doesn't shut him up, it just changes his pitch. He only goes quiet when the speech machine genuinely loses something:

\- Knock him out — it takes a few solid hits

\- Tape his mouth shut (it's in the desk drawer)

\- Put something heavy on his chest and let physics do the paperwork

And be careful with the spectacular solutions. Throw him out the window, and you'll learn this building has a PA system.

Some objects make him worse. The clicker. The whiteboard marker. A glass of water. The lectern. He was already at 100% — now he has slides.

How to play

\- Left-drag — grab and fling anything (including him)

\- Right-drag — orbit camera · Scroll — zoom

\- Right-click — use things: rummage drawers, slam the laptop, radio, fire alarm

\- R — restart the round

Rounds are 90 seconds. Your score is time-to-silence. Beat it.

This is an early playtest build (v0.1): one office, one talker, one deeply unimpressed capybara. Work-in-progress visuals, placeholder voice, everything subject to change. Tell me what made you laugh and what fell flat — comments are open.

Desktop browsers only, mouse required. \~30MB load.

[https://bubbleob.itch.io/he-still-has-the-floor-playtest](https://bubbleob.itch.io/he-still-has-the-floor-playtest)
